gloss: nuts and seeds; seed and fruit

definitions.gloss: nuts and seeds; seeds and fruits
definitions.explanation: A collective term for the edible seeds, nuts, and small dried fruits of plants. Used in food science, nutrition, and botany to refer to this food category as a group.

examples.japanese: {種実|しゅじつ}{類|るい}は{栄養|えいよう}が{豊富|ほうふ}だ。
examples.english: Nuts and seeds are rich in nutrition.

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}には{種実|しゅじつ}をたっぷり{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: This dish uses plenty of nuts and seeds.

examples.japanese: アーモンドやくるみなどの{種実|しゅじつ}{類|るい}には{良質|りょうしつ}な{脂肪|しぼう}が{含|ふく}まれており、{毎日|まいにち}{少量|しょうりょう}を{食|た}べることが{推奨|すいしょう}されている。
examples.english: Nuts and seeds such as almonds and walnuts contain high-quality fats, and eating a small amount daily is recommended.

notes:
A compound of {種|しゅ} (seed) and {実|じつ} (fruit/nut), used as a collective term for the broad category of edible seeds and nuts. Most commonly appears as {種実類|しゅじつるい} (the category of nuts and seeds) in nutrition and food science contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {種実|しゅじつ}{類|るい}: nuts and seeds (as a food category)
- {種実|しゅじつ}バター: nut/seed butter
- {種実|しゅじつ}アレルギー: nut/seed allergy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ナッツ: nuts (loanword, commonly used in casual speech)
- {木|き}の{実|み}: tree nuts; nuts from trees
- {種子|しゅし}: seed (botanical term, more technical)

USAGE:
While ナッツ is more common in everyday conversation, {種実|しゅじつ}{類|るい} is the standard term in nutritional guidelines, food labeling, and academic writing.
